title: The Cultural Gene of Large Language Models: A Study on the Impact of Cross-Corpus Training on Model Values and Biases
reasoning: This paper investigates cultural and ethical assumptions in LLMs by introducing the Cultural Probe Dataset (CPD). It specifically evaluates models using 'Value-Dilemma Probes' (VDP) which present forced-choice ethical dilemmas to reveal underlying value prioritizations. The work is explicitly framed within the context of 'AI Ethics' and 'Value Alignment'.
